subject: Dedicated region assurance acceptance and rollback scenarios
messages:
From: Michael Barnes <mbarnes@finsecure.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finsecure.com, legal@finsecure.com
Date: 2027-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Dedicated deployment - region, isolation and deletion evidence request

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are moving forward with a short internal review but need explicit confirmations around a few items before we can sign off on the Dedicated deployment for our production tenant:  

- Can Redwood guarantee that our tenant will be region-anchored (strict routing to us-west-2) for both active serving and backups?
- Are there physical/tenant-level isolation boundaries (no co-tenancy at the hypervisor or host level) and how are they validated?
- What's the documented process and SLA for tenant data deletion (full purge + cryptographic/operational proof)? We need timelines and sample evidence we can include in our audit.

Would you be able to provide an acceptance checklist and an example of the deletion proof we can share with our compliance team? If helpful, we can also share our standard MoU language for region/residency commitments.

Best,
Michael Barnes
Head of IT Security
FinSecure
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Barnes <mbarnes@finsecure.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment - region, isolation and deletion evidence request

Michael —

Appreciate the clear asks. Looping in Neha (Infrastructure & Privacy lead) and Karthik (Platform Ops) to provide a concise acceptance checklist and technical evidence we can deliver. I’m attaching a draft checklist (see attachment) that covers routing, backups, isolation, and the deletion timeline.

Quick snapshot of next steps from our side:  
- Neha will confirm host-level isolation and provide the wipe playbook extract.
- Karthik will scope the evidence artifacts we can produce (sample logs, snapshot deletion events).
- I’ll coordinate a short MoU draft and share a proposed timeline for proof delivery (we can aim for T+10 business days for artifacts after contract signature).

Attachment: draft-assurance-checklist.pdf (stub)

Can you confirm whether FinSecure requires notarized proofs or just signed attestations + logs? That will affect the MoU language.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Barnes <mbarnes@finsecure.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-01T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment - region, isolation and deletion evidence request

Michael / team —

Below are concrete answers and the operational artifacts we can produce. High level first, then the evidence list and deletion workflow.

1) Region anchoring (routing + backups)
- We support strict region affinity for Dedicated tenants. For your tenant we will configure control-plane routing and host affinity to us-west-2 nodes only. Backups and snapshots are stored in the same region by default; cross-region replication is opt-in and will be disabled for FinSecure unless explicitly requested.
- Evidence: routing table export, node allocation manifest, backup location metadata.

2) Isolation boundaries
- Dedicated customers get tenant-scoped GPU pools. We do not colocate tenant containers on shared host compute for Dedicated plans; tenant VMs are pinned to dedicated host pools. Isolation is enforced at the hypervisor (VM pinning) and container orchestration layer (tenant namespaces + network policies).
- Evidence: host allocation report, hypervisor acknowledgement (signed by ops lead), container namespace audit.

3) Deletion and purge process (SLA and proof)
- Workflow: customer requests tenant deletion -> we snapshot final tenant state for retention hold (if requested) -> we schedule wipe job across all attached volumes and KV caches -> run cryptographic zeroization + overwrite on ephemeral volumes -> decommission and recycle host assignment.
- SLA: standard Dedicated erase SLA is 30 business days for full proof package unless an expedited SLA (7 business days) is contracted.
- Evidence we can provide: per-host wipe logs, snapshot deletion events with timestamps, storage-level zeroization confirmations, and a signed attestation from Ops. We can also provide a sample deltas log (redacted) showing token-level scrub times.

Attachments included: dedicated-wipe-playbook.xlsx (operational steps), sample-wipe-log-snippet.txt (redacted)

Notes and caveats:
- For cryptographic/forensic audits FinSecure may ask for deeper host-level artifacts; we can coordinate a controlled review with an auditor under NDA.
- If FinSecure needs guaranteed physical separation (non-shared racks), we can discuss an upgraded Dedicated SLA with physical rack reservation (lead time applies).

If this aligns with what you need, I’ll compile the artifacts and send a consolidated package (logs + checklist + signed attestation).

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Infrastructure & Privacy | Redwood Inference
From: Michael Barnes <mbarnes@finsecure.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finsecure.com, legal@finsecure.com
Date: 2027-12-02T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment - region, isolation and deletion evidence request

Thanks Neha — that’s helpful. A couple follow-ups:  

- The 30 business day SLA for a full proof package is longer than our policy allows for decommission of environment data after failed PoCs. Can Redwood provide an expedited pathway (we can accept additional fee)?
- For auditability, we need an example package: signed attestation + per-host wipe logs + a sample snapshot deletion event (redacted). Can you confirm you can deliver that as a single bundle we can store in our GRC system?

Also, we typically require an MoU addendum that captures region anchoring and wipe SLA; could your legal team draft an initial version?

-Michael
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Barnes <mbarnes@finsecure.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, legal@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-02T12:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment - region, isolation and deletion evidence request

Michael —

We can offer an expedited proof package at T+7 business days for an expedited ops fee. I’ve attached a proposed MoU addendum (v1) for review — it includes the region anchoring commitments, backup location lock, and the expedited erase SLA option.

Attachment: proposed-mou-v1.pdf (draft)

Next steps I propose:  
1) FinSecure to confirm expedited SLA choice (standard vs expedited) and whether physical rack reservation is required.
2) Redwood legal will take your comments on the MoU and iterate.
3) Ops will prepare the sample evidence bundle and deliver it to your security mailbox; final total ETA will be given after signature.

I’ll also open a HubSpot ticket for tracking: https://hubspot.com/contacts/finsecure/DL-4721

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Barnes <mbarnes@finsecure.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-03T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment - region, isolation and deletion evidence request

Michael —

Confirming we will proceed with the expedited T+7 business day proof bundle if FinSecure signs the MoU addendum with the expedited ops fee. For visibility, the bundle will contain:  

- Signed attestation (Ops lead).
- Per-host wipe logs (redacted IPs/hostnames).
- Snapshot deletion events with UTC timestamps and storage object IDs.
- Storage-level zeroization confirmation and final decommission manifest.

I’ve placed a sample deletion log blob in our shared drive for your review: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-examples (redacted sample file: snapshot-deletion-sample.log). That sample demonstrates the output format and timestamps we include in the bundle.

If you accept the expedited SLA, we’ll start the artifact collection immediately after signature and target delivery within seven business days. If there are any DoD/NIST-specific formatting needs for your compliance system, let us know and we’ll adapt the export schema.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Infrastructure & Privacy | Redwood Inference
